WITH award_counts AS (
  SELECT throws, COUNT(*) as tally
  FROM manager_award m
  JOIN player p ON m.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY throws
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    throws,
    tally,
    tally * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(tally) FROM award_counts) as share
  FROM award_counts
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT SUM(tally) FROM with_shares CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc WHERE share > avg_share) as combined_tally,
  (SELECT AVG(share) FROM with_shares CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc WHERE share > avg_share) as avg_share_above,
  (SELECT AVG(share) FROM with_shares CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc WHERE share > avg_share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc) as distance_above_avg
